Sam: Heads up — I sketched a 'token signal' dashboard that shows effective per-token cost after cache/prefetch/batching. Wants to combine per-route + per-model toggles. Feedback? cc @Anya @Devin
Anya: Nice. Quick q — how do we attribute cache hits to routes vs prefetch slabs? last time we had ambiguity with shared prefetch pools
Devin: We can't do perfect attribution per invocation at our ingestion rates. I suggest weighted sampling + reconstructive joins to estimate per-route amortized credits.
Kelly: UX ask: default landing should be per-route aggregated. Add a compact toggle for per-model and per-tenant. Avoid showing raw per-invocation numbers by default.
Sam: rough SQL for the estimator prototype: ```
SELECT route, model_sku, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens,
  SUM(tokens * unit_price * (1 - cache_credit)) / SUM(tokens) AS effective_unit_cost
FROM sampled_invocations
JOIN cache_events USING (request_id)
GROUP BY route, model_sku;
```
Devin: That works as a start. We also need to track batching impact (batch_size distribution) since batching reduces marginal cost. Add `batch_size` and `kv_cache_hit` into the join.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T14:12:03Z succeeded for infra/telemetry-ingest v2.1 :white_check_mark:
Anya: Edge-case: routed fallbacks (e.g., route tries r‑v1 then falls back to small model) — do we amortize the extra tokens to the original route or split by final model? I think split by invocation path with a primary attribution to the initiating route.
Devin: Agreed. Implementation plan: ingest raw tokens -> join with cache_event stream -> emit an "attribution_event" that contains fields: `request_id`, `route`, `model_sku_chain`, `tokens`, `cache_credit`, `batch_size`, `tenant_id`. Then dashboard can aggregate deterministically on those events.
Kelly: For frontend: small sparkline per-route, hover shows 7d avg effective_unit_cost, cache_credit %, and avg latency. Also a per-tenant button to switch context. Keep charts lightweight.
Sam: Operational question: sampling rate? I propose 1% full-fidelity sampling + 0.1% full traces for debugging. Use extrapolation for totals. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Devin: 1% sounds reasonable as a start. We should store reservoir sample keys so we can backfill cache joins for sampled items.
Anya: For math: we'll use weighted estimates and attach a confidence score (CI) per metric. That will let console flag low-confidence data.
Kelly: UX: show a little badge if confidence < 80% and `?` tooltip explaining sampling. :information_source:
Sam: OK — owners? Devin for pipeline, Anya for attribution math, Kelly for frontend. I'll wire an internal doc and a canary rollout plan (10% tenants first). :rocket:
Devin: I'll kick off the ingestion PR today and add schema drafts to the repo.
Anya: I'll write the estimator spec and a unit test harness for correctness on synthetic workloads.
Kelly: I'll mock the UI and send a Figma link by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks team — aim to have MVP in next sprint. Posting the design doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/token-signal-mvp (proto)
